file.description: products.csv, assets.csv, products.xlsx, assets.xlsx (Excel import, a node feature) or the image file name.

row.description: 1-based data row; for a workbook (products.xlsx, assets.xlsx) the Excel row number, header = row 1. null for header, file-level and image-file problems.

severity.description: error: row/file skipped. warning: imported, with a correction or a label completeness warning.

obx_error.description: An error code, or for severity warning also a label completeness warning code.
